_about: Co-folding targets. The protein sequence is the full deposited sequence of the entity (SEQRES), fetched from RCSB; the ligand is given as its CCD code. build_data.py writes an AlphaFold Server style job JSON for each, which LocalFold (localfold.org) reads. AlphaFold Server uses the same format but only allows a short list of ligands, which does not include these.

targets.note: Smallest and fastest to fold. In nature a tetramer; one chain is folded here, so the lid that a neighbouring chain puts over biotin (Trp120) is missing.
Small ligand in a well-defined pocket.
The practical's main case. Larger, so slower in the browser.
